nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Technology transfer for climate action_qna_000
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is one of the essential strategies mentioned for managing climate-induced migration in Africa?
nodes.answer: Investing in innovative technologies alongside renewable energy sources and crops resistant to climate change is one of the essential strategies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Technology transfer for climate action_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How can the diffusion of technologies within a nation be facilitated through the financialization channel?
nodes.answer: The diffusion of technologies within a nation can be pushed through the financialization channel by helping sectors initiate the carbon reduction process and realize the need for cleaner energy alternatives.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Technology transfer for climate action_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: According to empirical studies, what factor is predicted to enhance the feasibility of adopting renewable-energy technology in nations?
nodes.answer: Greater trade openness is predicted to enhance the feasibility of adopting renewable-energy technology in nations.
